name: SikaFiber Novocon CHE-8060 HT

SIKAFIBER® NOVOCON® CHE-8060 HT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT, June 2025, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sikafiber-novoconche-8060ht.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description. SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT steel fibers are designed specifically for the reinforcement of concrete. SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT is a cold drawn glued hooked end high strength steel fibre, to provide optimum anchorage within the concrete.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Industrial slabs
    - Jointless flooring
    - Tunnel precast segments
    - Blast resistant concrete
    - High strength concrete application
    - Road and road repairing concrete

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Collated hooked ends steel fibres
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Compliance.
    - SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT complies with European Standard EN 14889-1:2006 Fibres for Concrete Part 1: Group I .
    - It also conforms to ASTM A820/A820M-04, Type I cold drawn wire.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 14889-1:2006: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports > Compliance: (p.1).
    - ASTM A820: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports > Compliance: (p.1).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Provides uniform multi-directional concrete reinforcement
    - Increases crack resistance, ductility, energy absorption or toughness of concrete
    - Improves impact resistance, fatigue endurance and shear strength of concrete
    - High tensile strength fiber bridging joints and cracks to provide tighter aggregate interlock resulting in increased load-carrying capacity
    - Requires less labor to incorporate into concrete than conventional reinforcement
    - Offers economical concrete reinforcement solutions with greater project scheduling accuracy
    - Ideally suited for hand or vibratory screeds, laser-screeds and all conventional finishing equipment
2.5 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Dimensions: Length (l) 60 mm, diameter (d) 0.75 mm. Aspect ratio (l/d) 80.
    - Tensile strength: ≥ 2100 MPa
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 1200 kg bulk bag; 10 kg bag
    - Shelf life: If stored in dry conditions shelf life is 3 years.
    - Storage conditions: The pallets should be protected against rain and snow. Do NOT stack pallets on top of each other.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2025, Version 01.04) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2025, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Compatibility: SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT steel fibres are compatible with all curing compounds, superplasticisers, water reducers, hardeners and coatings.
4.3 Recommended dosage. The dosage of the SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT will vary according to the type of application and the required performance. Standard recommended dosage rate of SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT is between 15–40 kg/m³ of concrete. Dosages outside the recommended dosage range can be used to meet project specific requirements. If this is the case please contact your Sika representative for technical support.
4.4 Application.
    - Placing
    - SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT steel fibres can be pumped and placed using conventional equipment. Hand or vibratory screeds and laser screeds can be used with SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT steel fibres.
    - Finishing
    - Conventional finishing techniques and equipment can be used when finishing SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE- 8060 HT steel fibre concrete. In some cases an extra bull float process is advised and lowering the angle of the power float blades will help to minimize fibre exposure on the surface.
4.5 Dispensing.
    - SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT steel fibres can be added during or after the batching of the concrete but should never be added as the first component. Such devices as conveyor belts, chutes and dispensers may be used to add fibres to the mixer at the ready mix plant. Extra precautions should be taken in wet weather conditions as fibres could separate before mixing with concrete.
    - After the fibres have been added, the concrete should be mixed for sufficient time (4-5 minutes at full mixing speed) to ensure uniform distribution of the fibres throughout the concrete. The use of a water reducing admixture is reccommended to achieve the desired concrete workability.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2025, Version 01.04) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFiber® Novocon® CHE-8060 HT, June 2025, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/d/sikafiber-novoconche-8060ht.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
